required_facts.description: The validate_email function and its EMAIL_RE regex are removed entirely from validators.py; validators.py no longer performs any email validation.
A new function also named validate_email is added to utils.py, but it only checks for the presence of an '@' character rather than the anchored regex pattern the old validators.py function used.

Despite the same function name reappearing in a different file, this is not a behavior-preserving move or rename: the validation logic materially weakens from an anchored full-string regex match to a simple '@' substring check, so many invalid strings (e.g. 'a@' or '@@@') that the old function rejected are now accepted.
